source_caption:
Silo Season 3 spoilers warning! 

Insane penultimate episode of Silo. Easily the best hour of the season.

Episode 9, "Farewell," truly earned every bit of its record-breaking 9.3 IMDb rating by delivering the exact kind of high-stakes, gut-wrenching payoff fans have been waiting for since the very first episode.

The episode delivers massive flashbacks to the opening days of the silos and a shocking nuclear explosion, leading to intense fan theories about the Founders and the true nature of the project. Stensen swore up and down the threat was nanotechnology, not nuclear war. Then the silos open to the public and a bomb goes off in the same city on the exact same day. Coincidence, or did he need a reason for them to exist badly enough to make one happen. 

What are your thoughts on Silo Finale?

source_details.title: Silo
source_details.synopsis: Silo is a 2019 American thriller drama film directed by Marshall Burnette and starring Jim Parrack, Jill Paice, Jack DiFalco, Jeremy Holm, Danny Ramirez and Chris Ellis. The film premiered at the 2019 Louisville's International Festival of Film.
